T.why: true NTC temperature, -20..+60 degC (K because the law has 1/T)

Vsh.why: self-heating is evaluated at Vcc = 3.6 V (continuous measurement)

xn.why: node ratio x = Rx/(Rx+Rp) at the true temperature

E_R25.why: |T_inferred - T| from R25 at its tolerance limit (worse sign)

E_Rpar.why: same, from the parallel resistor (about 0 when none)

Etot.why: sum of the absolute error items

define.TiRparp: 1/(1/T0 + ln(((Rn*(RPAR.R*(1 + RPAR.t))/(Rn + RPAR.R*(1 + RPAR.t)))*RPAR.R/(RPAR.R - (Rn*(RPAR.R*(1 + RPAR.t))/(Rn + RPAR.R*(1 + RPAR.t)))))/NTC.R25)/NTC.B)
define.TiAdcp: 1/(1/T0 + ln(((RP.R*(Rxn + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R))/(RP.R - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)))*RPAR.R/(RPAR.R - (RP.R*(Rxn + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R))/(RP.R - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)))))/NTC.R25)/NTC.B)
define.TiRparm: 1/(1/T0 + ln(((Rn*(RPAR.R*(1 - RPAR.t))/(Rn + RPAR.R*(1 - RPAR.t)))*RPAR.R/(RPAR.R - (Rn*(RPAR.R*(1 - RPAR.t))/(Rn + RPAR.R*(1 - RPAR.t)))))/NTC.R25)/NTC.B)
define.TiAdcm: 1/(1/T0 + ln(((RP.R*(Rxn - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R))/(RP.R + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)))*RPAR.R/(RPAR.R - (RP.R*(Rxn - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R))/(RP.R + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)))))/NTC.R25)/NTC.B)

laws.source: divider: x = Rx/(Rx+Rp), Rx = R_NTC || R_par, R_NTC = R25 exp(B(1/T-1/T0))

laws.zfl: E_R25 == max(max(TiR25p - T, T - TiR25p), max(TiR25m - T, T - TiR25m))
laws.source: change of inferred T when R25 sits at +-tolerance, others nominal

laws.zfl: E_B == max(max(TiBp - T, T - TiBp), max(TiBm - T, T - TiBm))
E_Rp == max(max(TiRpp - T, T - TiRpp), max(TiRpm - T, T - TiRpm))
E_Rpar == max(max(TiRparp - T, T - TiRparp), max(TiRparm - T, T - TiRparm))
E_adc == max(max(TiAdcp - T, T - TiAdcp), max(TiAdcm - T, T - TiAdcm))
laws.source: ADC +-(TUE+0.5 LSB) in ratio units, inverted by the firmware
P_NTC = V_NTC^2/R_NTC, dT_sh = P_NTC/delta; V_NTC = Vcc*x

laws.zfl: Etot == E_R25 + E_B + E_Rp + E_Rpar + E_adc + Tsh
laws.source: error stack: sum of absolute items

requirements.why: R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [273.15,283.15] K
R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [283.15,293.15] K
R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [293.15,303.15] K
R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [303.15,313.15] K

R1: total error <= 1 K for T in [263.15,273.15] K
R1: total error <= 1 K for T in [313.15,323.15] K
R1: total error <= 1 K for T in [323.15,333.15] K
